# Windy, Even When It Is Blocked

This release makes the card tell you what is wrong when Windy cannot be loaded, stops the map from reloading on GPS noise, and locks the embedded Windy frames down.

## When Windy does not load

- **A stalled map now offers a way out.** Before, a blocked `embed.windy.com` (for example by an ad blocker) or an offline browser left an empty box, and Reset was the only thing to try. Now a frame that has not loaded within 15 seconds, or that loaded while offline, shows a notice with a Retry button, translated into the card's languages.
- **A refused request is detected, too.** Before, an ad blocker made the browser show its own error page inside the frame, which looked like a successful load, so the box stayed empty without any notice. The card now checks that Windy really answers and shows the Retry notice if it does not.
- **The card recovers on its own.** It reloads stalled frames when the browser comes back online or the tab becomes visible again (at most every 30 seconds), and a card that was disconnected and reconnected on the dashboard picks up its watch again instead of staying blank.

## Location and configuration

- **A moving tracker no longer reloads the map.** Before, a `location` entity such as a phone reported unrounded coordinates, so every GPS update built a new URL and reloaded Windy. The position is now rounded to three decimals (about 100 m), so the map only reloads when the device really moves.
- **An unquoted `aspect_ratio` works.** Before, `aspect_ratio: 16:9` without quotes was read by YAML as the number 969 and the card came up empty with no message. The common ratios (16:9, 4:3, 3:2, 2:1, 1:1, 21:9) are now recognised, and any other non-string value gives an error that says to quote the ratio. _[#66]_

## Privacy and security

- **The Windy frames are sandboxed.** Before, both iframes ran without restrictions. They now keep scripts, their own origin and popups, which Windy needs, and block top-level navigation, modal dialogs and downloads. Geolocation delegation through `allow_geolocation` keeps working. _[#68]_
- **The README explains what Windy receives.** A new Privacy section states that Windy sees your IP address and the map or spot coordinates, and may set its own cookies, and that nothing else is sent by the card.

## Behind the scenes

Dependencies, the GitHub Actions workflows and the end-to-end test setup were updated; none of this changes how the card behaves.

## Upgrading

Update through HACS and reload the dashboard resource (a hard refresh of the browser is enough). No configuration changes are needed. If you had an unquoted `aspect_ratio` that failed before, it now works as written.
